info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Webhook Endpoint Configuration API
info.description: The Manage Webhook Endpoint Configuration API enables businesses to update the settings of existing webhook endpoints. This operation allows for the modification of the parameters that dictate how incoming notifications are handled. Typical users of this API include developers and system integrators who need to maintain effective communication between applications through dynamic webhook configurations. The API facilitates seamless integration by allowing real-time changes to webhook behaviors, enhancing adaptability in response to evolving business requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the configurations of a specific webhook identified by its ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to update the relevant fields.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the webhook endpoint configuration. It should include the necessary fields specified in the schema to modify the existing resource effectively.
